# livekit_sip_inbound_trunk (Resource)

An inbound SIP trunk: which calls LiveKit accepts from a SIP provider, to which numbers and from which addresses and callers. A `livekit_sip_dispatch_rule` then decides which room a call goes to. The API refuses a trunk that conflicts with another, such as one that accepts the same number from the same callers, and one open to anyone: set `numbers`, `allowed_addresses`, or `auth_username` with `auth_password`. Every change is made in place. Settings the provider does not model, such as media codecs, are kept as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "sip_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Calls from a SIP provider to one number, from its addresses only.
resource "livekit_sip_inbound_trunk" "twilio" {
  name              = "twilio"
  numbers           = ["+14155550100"]
  allowed_addresses = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
  auth_username     = "livekit"
  auth_password     = var.sip_password
  ringing_timeout   = 30
  max_call_duration = 3600
  krisp_enabled     = true

  headers_to_attributes = {
    "X-Customer-Id" = "customer_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_addresses` (Set of String) IP addresses or CIDR ranges calls are accepted from. Not set, from anywhere.
- `allowed_numbers` (Set of String) Caller numbers the trunk accepts. Not set, any caller. Numbers are in E.164 format, such as `+14155550100`.
- `attributes_to_headers` (Map of String) Maps participant attributes (keys) to SIP X-* headers (values) sent with BYE or REFER.
- `auth_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for SIP digest authentication. The API never returns it, so a password changed outside Terraform is not detected; one that was removed is. It is stored in the state.
- `auth_realm` (String) Realm for SIP digest authentication. Defaults to `""`.
- `auth_username` (String) Username for SIP digest authentication. Defaults to `""`, no authentication.
- `headers` (Map of String) SIP X-* headers to include in the 200 OK response, by name.
- `headers_to_attributes` (Map of String) Maps SIP X-* headers of the INVITE (keys) to participant attributes (values).
- `include_headers` (String) Which INVITE headers become `sip.h.*` participant attributes automatically. One of `none`, `x_headers`, `all`. Defaults to `none`.
- `krisp_enabled` (Boolean) Apply Krisp noise cancellation to callers. Defaults to `false`.
- `max_call_duration` (Number) Longest a call may last. In seconds. LiveKit's default applies when not set.
- `media_encryption` (String) Media encryption (SRTP) for calls. One of `disable`, `allow`, `require`. Defaults to `disable`.
- `metadata` (String) Free-form metadata for the trunk. Defaults to `""`.
- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the trunk. Defaults to `""`.
- `numbers` (Set of String) Numbers the trunk accepts calls to. Several trunks with different numbers give one provider different rules. Numbers are in E.164 format, such as `+14155550100`.
- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`) the trunk belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the trunk is created; a later change of that default does not move it. Changing this argument replaces the trunk.
- `ringing_timeout` (Number) How long the caller waits for the call to be answered. In seconds. LiveKit's default applies when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Trunk ID (`ST_...`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an inbound trunk by "<project_id>/<trunk_id>". Its password cannot be
# read, so set auth_password in the configuration and apply once.
terraform import livekit_sip_inbound_trunk.twilio p_abc123/ST_abcdef123456
```
